verdict.rationale: Formant's own materials say users can ask the fleet questions in plain language and receive ML-driven task recommendations, and that Analytics includes an AI assistant for building dashboards. The recommendation claim comes from a marketing page, though, and the AI assistant is documented only as a dashboard-building aid, not as a source of insights into the data, so complete coverage is not shown. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how AI insights and suggestions are generated from fleet data, evidence that the analytics AI assistant surfaces insights rather than only building dashboards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask your fleet what's happening in plain language and get governed, ML-driven task recommendations — with people approving what happens next.
Using built-in visualizations, custom SQL queries, or our AI assistant, you can build a rich dashboard for your devices.
